renderings.value: Expresses that just doing something is not enough or will not suffice.

The grammar point ～ではすまない is used when the speaker strongly feels that an action or situation alone is not sufficient or acceptable, implying that more serious measures are needed or that the consequences are more severe.
Verb-dictionary form + ではすまない / い-Adjective + ではすまない / な-Adjective + ではすまない / Noun + ではすまない
ではすまない: X alone won't settle it (謝るだけではすまない).
Just apologizing will not suffice. Some action needs to be taken.
This problem won't be solved with just discussions. A concrete plan is needed.
His failure won't be resolved with just a warning. He should take responsibility.
This mistake cannot be settled with money alone. To regain trust, an earnest apology is needed.
